messages.quest.end_survey.choose_a_star.descripti: Choose a chorus trail or an End City light for the survey.
messages.quest.end_survey.choose_a_star.scene.end: Chorus trail. Map the living purple route, even when its fruit disagrees with distance.
City light. Map the pale towers, the void between them, and every shell pretending to be stone.
One point of End light is circled in the survey ledger. The route now belongs to your choice.
quest.end_survey.choose_a_star.stage.cho: The outer islands offer two lights: chorus groves close to the ground, or End rods high in a city.
